objects.name: Hannah R.
objects.quote: It felt less like a photo shoot and more like going for a hike with a friend who happens to carry a very good camera.

objects.name: Priya and Sam
objects.quote: We hate having our picture taken. An hour in, we'd forgotten it was happening, and those are the photos on our wall now.

objects.name: The Okafor family
objects.quote: Three kids, one wet dog and no patience. Wren just walked along with us and somehow came back with the best pictures we've ever had.
